title: Fix LRU cache recency and validation
instruction: Fix LruCache in src/lru.mjs. get() of an existing key and set() of an existing key both make that key the most recently used. has() does not change recency. get() of a missing key returns undefined and does not insert anything. A stored value of undefined still counts as present for has(). When size exceeds the limit, the least recently used entry is evicted. The constructor throws RangeError unless limit is a positive integer.

acceptanceCriteria: set of an existing key refreshes recency
materialDefectsInFixture: set of existing key keeps old position
